mcqs.q: Light year is a unit of:
If one EM wave has a higher frequency than another, what is true about its wavelength?
options: It is also longer, because both increase together.
It is unchanged — only the speed differs.
Kinetic energy stays the same because mass hasn't changed.
It is shorter — wavelength and frequency are inversely related (c = f x lambda).

mcqs.q: When you push a wall, what does Newton's third law say about the wall?
options: It is unchanged — only the speed differs.
The wall exerts an equal and opposite force on you at the same instant.
The wall pushes back with a force proportional to how stiff it is, not equal to your force.
The wall only pushes back if your force is strong enough to make it react.

mcqs.q: If a car doubles its speed, what happens to its kinetic energy?
options: Kinetic energy doubles because energy is proportional to speed.
It quadruples (because KE = 1/2 mv^2 — kinetic energy is proportional to v^2).
The wall pushes back with a force proportional to how stiff it is, not equal to your force.
Kinetic energy stays the same because mass hasn't changed.
